title: GHL Automation & AI Workflow Specialist
description:
Part-Time | Remote | Initial Project with Potential for Ongoing Work



ABOUT IS

The Creative Seed Coaching (Perfect-Fit Job Program) is an executive career coaching and professional development company helping senior leaders land the right next role and build fulfilling, successful careers.



WHAT I'M LOOKING FOR

I'm looking for someone with strong hands-on experience in GoHighLevel (GHL) who can maintain, improve, and build automations within our existing account.



A second important area is AI-powered lead generation and research for our executive job search clients.

We currently use LinkedIn Sales Navigator to identify relevant senior decision-makers, HR leaders, and executive recruiters. We'd like to streamline the research and list-building process using AI and automation to produce accurate, well-organized spreadsheets of targeted networking contacts.



The goal is to reduce repetitive manual work, improve accuracy, and create reliable processes that can scale as our business grows.



CURRENT & FUTURE STATE

We already have GoHighLevel set up, with CRM pipelines, client communications, and several automations in place.

We're not looking for someone to build a new GHL account from scratch. We need someone who can understand how our business operates, assess what's working and what needs improvement, and translate our processes into reliable automations.



Priorities:

- Improve the reliability and efficiency of existing workflows.

- Reduce manual administrative work for our small team.

- Strengthen prospect follow-up, client onboarding, and program management.

- Improve visibility into where prospects and clients are in their journey.

- Use AI and automation to make client networking research and contact-list creation faster and more accurate.



The Kind of Work We Need Help With



1. GoHighLevel CRM & Automation

- Building, improving, and troubleshooting GHL workflows.

- Managing CRM pipelines and automatically moving contacts between stages.

- Automated and scheduled prospect and client
s.

- Tags, custom fields, contact records, and segmentation.

- Forms, calendars, appointment scheduling, and reminders.

- Program enrollment, onboarding, milestones, renewals, and follow-up.

- Payment links, installment payment reminders, and payment-related workflows.

- Internal notifications and team task assignments.

- Testing automations, identifying errors, and preventing missed communications.

- Recommending opportunities to simplify and automate our current processes.



2. AI & LinkedIn Sales Navigator Lead Generation

We provide targeted networking campaigns for senior-level job seekers. An important first step is identifying the right people at the right companies.



We'd like help developing a more automated process to:

- Research target companies based on each client's industry, role, geography, and career goals.

- Identify senior decision-makers, hiring leaders, CHROs, HR executives, and relevant recruiters using LinkedIn Sales Navigator.

- Organize contacts into accurate, structured Excel or Google Sheets files.

- Use ChatGPT, Claude, and other appropriate AI tools to accelerate research, categorization, and quality checks.

- Reduce manual copying, data cleanup, and repetitive list preparation.

- Create a repeatable process that can be customized for individual clients.



We're looking for practical solutions that respect platform restrictions and data privacy requirements, rather than unreliable scraping methods.



3. Business Process Improvement

Beyond individual automations, we'd value someone who can look at how our systems work together and identify opportunities to simplify operations.

This might include connecting GHL with our scheduling,
, payment, client tracking, and reporting tools.



Tools We Use

Essential experience:

- GoHighLevel (GHL) — strong hands-on automation experience.

- LinkedIn Sales Navigator — familiarity with prospect research and targeted list building.

- ChatGPT and/or Claude — practical experience using AI to improve business workflows.



Additional experience is a plus:

- CRM & Automation: Zapier, Airtable, Guidance Gate

- AI & Meeting Tools: Fathom

- Sales & Networking: LinkedIn, Expandi

- Scheduling & Marketing: Calendly, Mailchimp

- Business Tools: Google Workspace, Gmail, Microsoft Excel, Google Sheets

- Payments: Stripe



You don't need expertise in every tool. Strong GHL and AI-enablement skills, practical problem-solving, and the ability to connect systems are the priorities.



WHO I'M LOOKING FOR:



You should have real experience building and maintaining automations in GoHighLevel, rather than simply general familiarity with the platform. Ideally, you're someone who:

- Can quickly understand an existing GHL account and how its workflows connect.

- Understands business processes and can recommend simple, dependable solutions.

- Has experience with AI-assisted research, data organization, or lead-generation workflows.

- Can implement, test, document, and troubleshoot what you build.

- Communicates clearly and explains technical decisions in plain English.

- Is comfortable working independently with a small business owner and remote team.

- Is thoughtful about cost and avoids unnecessary tools or overly complicated solutions.



I don't necessarily know the technical terminology for everything I want to achieve. I need someone who can ask the right questions, understand the intended result, and turn that into a working solution.



TO APPLY



Please answer the following:

- How long have you worked with GoHighLevel?

- What types of GHL automations have you built?

- Describe a relatively complex automation you've implemented and the business problem it solved.

- Are you comfortable improving an existing GHL setup rather than starting from scratch?

- Have you built AI-assisted lead-generation, LinkedIn Sales Navigator research, or automated spreadsheet workflows? Please describe an example.

- What is your hourly rate and preferred working arrangement?

- What is your availability and time zone?



Please also send a short Loom or video showing an automation you've built in GoHighLevel, explaining what it does and how it works. You can use a demonstration account or remove confidential client information.



INITIAL PROJECT & OPPORTUNITY



We'd like to begin with a small, paid project reviewing our existing GHL setup, identifying the highest-priority improvements, and implementing one agreed-upon automation.



This will give us an opportunity to evaluate your technical skills, communication, and working style.



If we're a good fit, we'd like to develop an ongoing relationship for GHL maintenance, additional automations, and AI-assisted process improvements.

We’re hiring Family Case Managers to compassionately guide families through our full service lifecycle - from contract signature to the safe return of their loved one's ashes.

title: Video Editor for Healthcare Entrepreneur and Assisted Living Brand
description:
Video Editor & Social Media Creative Assistant

Short-Form, Long-Form & AI-Assisted Content

Remote | Long-Term Opportunity | Paid Per Video | Professional Training Opportunities



We're Looking for More Than Just a Video Editor

We're building multiple social media brands and are looking for a creative, motivated video editor who understands what makes people stop scrolling, watch a video, and engage with content.

We want someone who brings ideas to the table, thinks independently, communicates confidently, and is willing to grow with our team.



You don't need to be an expert in every editing program or AI tool. We're willing to invest in professional editing courses, classes, and ongoing training for the right person.

However, you should already have hands-on editing experience and be able to show us examples of social media content you've helped make successful.



Most importantly, we're looking for someone who can recognize when something could be better—and confidently recommend how to improve it.

We don't want someone who simply follows instructions. We want someone who contributes creatively while respecting our brand, our audience, and our final approval process.



IMPORTANT: In the subject line use PURPLE VIDEO EDITOR. or you will not be considered.



What You'll Be Working On



1. Elena Merchand's Personal Brand

Elena is a nurse, Certified Dementia Practitioner, dementia educator, and owner of an assisted living and memory care community.

She creates educational content helping families navigate dementia behaviors, caregiver stress, aging, and senior care decisions.

Content includes:

Instagram Reels, TikTok videos, and YouTube Shorts.

Educational talking-head videos.

Demonstrations and instructional content.

Storytelling and recurring educational series.

Long-form educational videos.

Course and webinar content.



2. Our AI Influencer Family

We're developing an original fictional AI family centered around aging, dementia, and caregiving.

The content combines entertainment, humor, education, recurring characters, and episodic storytelling.

You'll help create scenes using Higgsfield and other AI tools while maintaining consistency in characters, settings, voices, and visual style.



3. Our Senior Care Businesses

You'll also help produce content for our assisted living community and care management company, including:

Recruitment videos.

Community and lifestyle videos.

Facility tours.

Educational and promotional content.

Social media campaigns.



4. Long-Form Content

You'll edit educational videos, YouTube content, interviews, courses, and webinar recordings, typically 5–20 minutes long.

You'll also help repurpose longer videos into engaging short-form clips.

Platforms: Instagram,
, TikTok, YouTube, and LinkedIn.



What We're Looking For



1. Strong Social Media Instincts

We need someone who understands—or is actively developing an understanding of—what makes social media content effective.

You should be able to evaluate a video beyond whether it looks polished.



The First Three Seconds

Does the video immediately grab attention?

Would the opening make someone stop scrolling?

Is the hook compelling, relevant, and easy to understand?

Is there a stronger way to open the video?

Does the opening visual support the message?



On-Screen Text

Is the text clear, accurate, and compelling?

Is the hook too long or difficult to read?

Are the words positioned correctly?

Is the font large enough for a mobile screen?

Does the text reinforce the message rather than distract from it?

Are captions and overlays within platform-safe zones?



Viewer Retention

Does the video move at the right pace?

Are there unnecessary pauses or repetitive sections?

Could B-roll, graphics, or a different visual improve engagement?

Are transitions natural rather than distracting?

Does the content remain interesting throughout?



Calls to Action

Is the CTA clear and appropriate?

Does the on-screen CTA match the approved campaign?

Is the viewer being guided toward the intended next step?

We want someone who can identify problems, think through solutions, and suggest improvements before the final video is submitted.



2. Confidence to Share Creative Opinions

This is one of our most important requirements.

We're not looking for someone who automatically agrees with every instruction.

We want someone who is comfortable respectfully offering a different perspective when they believe something could be improved.

For example:

"I think the first three seconds could be stronger. Here's another approach."

"The on-screen hook is too long. I recommend shortening it."

"This section feels slow. I think adding a visual here would improve retention."

"I noticed that our previous videos performed better when we used this type of opening."

"I think this video would work better with a different editing style, and here's why."

You should be comfortable explaining your reasoning and contributing ideas based on your experience, observations, and performance data.

We value initiative, constructive feedback, creative confidence, and professional collaboration.

We also expect you to respect final creative decisions once they're approved.



3. Excellent Communication and Interpersonal Skills

We work closely with our creative team, and communication is essential.

You must be comfortable communicating through phone calls, WhatsApp, and video meetings—not just text messages.

We're looking for someone who is:

Friendly, personable, and professional.

Confident speaking and expressing ideas in English.

Comfortable participating in creative discussions.

Willing to ask questions rather than make assumptions.

Able to give and receive constructive feedback.

Respectful when opinions differ.

Proactive in providing updates.

Comfortable discussing problems and proposing solutions.

Dependable and responsive during agreed working hours.

Elena enjoys building genuine working relationships with her team.

We want someone who communicates naturally, enjoys collaborating, and isn't afraid to pick up the phone to discuss an idea or problem.

Don't wait until a deadline is missed to tell us something isn't working.



4. Willingness to Learn and Develop Professionally

We're willing to invest in the right person.

We may provide access to:

Professional video editing classes and courses.

Advanced CapCut or Adobe Premiere Pro training.

Social media storytelling and retention training.

AI video creation and editing courses.

Tutorials and professional development resources.

Ongoing creative coaching and feedback.

You do not need to know every tool before joining us.

However, you must already have a foundation in video editing and demonstrate the motivation to improve.

In return for our investment, we expect you to:

Take training seriously.

Practice new techniques.

Apply what you've learned.

Stay curious about emerging editing and AI technologies.

Avoid repeating mistakes after receiving feedback.

Look for opportunities to improve the quality and efficiency of your work.

We're happy to teach technical skills. We're looking for someone who already brings initiative, accountability, curiosity, and a strong work ethic.



5. Demonstrated Social Media Results — Required

You must be able to show us actual examples of social media content you've worked on that achieved measurable results.

You must provide at least ONE of the following:



Option A: An Account You Helped Grow

Provide:

A link to the social media account.

The follower count when you started working on it.

The follower count after your involvement.

Screenshots demonstrating account growth.

A description of your role in creating, editing, or managing its content.



Option B: A Successful Video or Post You Created for a Client

Provide:

A link to the actual published post or video.

Screenshots showing performance, such as views, reach, engagement, shares, saves, or followers gained.

An explanation of what you personally contributed.

Why you believe the content performed well.

We don't require you to have grown an account to thousands of followers.

But we do require real examples, actual performance screenshots, and the ability to explain your creative decisions.

We want someone who understands the connection between editing decisions and audience engagement.



6. Video Editing Skills

You should already be comfortable editing videos using at least one established editing program.

Preferred editing software:

CapCut Desktop.

Adobe Premiere Pro.

DaVinci Resolve or comparable professional software.

You do not need to be proficient in all of them.

You should be able to:

Edit short-form and long-form videos.

Remove filler words and unnecessary pauses naturally.

Add accurate captions and on-screen text.

Incorporate B-roll, graphics, zooms, and visual transitions.

Maintain clear, consistent audio.

Follow established templates and brand guidelines.

Export correctly for different platforms.

Review your own work for mistakes before submitting it.

Experience with transcript-based editing, audio cleanup, AI-generated visuals, and eye-contact correction is beneficial.



7. AI Tools and Technology

We use AI tools extensively to make production faster and more creative.

Our current tools include:

Tool

Primary Use

Higgsfield

AI-generated scenes, B-roll, characters, and video

CapCut Pro

Video editing, captions, and AI editing features

ElevenLabs

Voice and audio production

Grok / GrokBot

AI content and workflow assistance

OpenArt / Seedance

AI video generation

ChatGPT and Claude

Scripts, hooks, captions, and creative research

Canva

Graphics, covers, and overlays

ManyChat

Social media comment and DM automation

Meta Business Suite

Social media scheduling

Dropbox

Shared footage and project files



You do not need to know every tool.

We're willing to train someone who is comfortable learning new technology.

However, you should be able to research solutions, troubleshoot basic issues, and become increasingly independent.

We use AI to improve production efficiency—not as a substitute for quality control or creative judgment.



Your Day-to-Day Responsibilities



Short-Form Video Editing

Most videos will be approximately 30–90 seconds.

You'll:

Review raw footage and editing briefs.

Evaluate the first three seconds and suggest stronger hooks when appropriate.

Create engaging, well-paced edits.

Add accurate captions, on-screen hooks, and CTA overlays.

Source or generate appropriate B-roll.

Include graphics and visual elements that support the message.

Check readability, timing, placement, and spelling.

Maintain consistency with our approved brand designs.

Deliver polished videos ready for review.



Long-Form Video Editing

You'll:

Edit 5–20 minute educational and YouTube videos.

Improve pacing and remove unnecessary material.

Add chapters, B-roll, graphics, and clean audio.

Identify opportunities to repurpose longer videos.

Create approximately 3–5 short clips from a long-form video when included in the project scope.

Creative Input and Content Development



You'll help our team:

Evaluate hooks before editing begins.

Identify opportunities to strengthen scripts.

Suggest on-screen wording that is more compelling.

Recommend editing formats that may improve engagement.

Identify successful content patterns.

Suggest visual storytelling techniques.

Develop ideas for future videos.

We want your creative input, not just technical execution.



Social Media Support



You'll also:

Help write and refine post captions.

Prepare thumbnails and video covers.

Schedule approved posts on the assigned platforms at the assigned times.

Confirm posts were successfully published.

Verify that relevant links and comment-keyword automations are ready.

Review basic performance metrics when requested.



Nothing is published without approval.



How We Work



Our Expectations

1. Follow Our Brand Design Systems

We have established brand guidelines, fonts, templates, and visual styles.

Your creative suggestions are welcome, but changes must be approved before implementation.

2. Follow the Editing Brief

Every video may include a storyboard, hook, CTA, visual references, and editing notes.

Follow the brief, but speak up if you believe something could be improved.

3. Think Before You Edit

Don't simply place text on a screen because it appears in the instructions.

Evaluate whether the text is readable, compelling, accurate, and appropriate for the platform.

If you recommend changing the wording or visual treatment, explain why and request approval.

4. Quality-Check Your Own Work

Before submitting a video, check:

First three seconds and hook strength.

Spelling and caption accuracy.

On-screen text timing and placement.

Visual quality and pacing.

Audio levels.

Correct CTA and brand styling.

Export settings and platform formatting.

5. Learn From Feedback

We understand that revisions are part of the creative process.

However, we expect you to remember feedback and apply it to future videos.

6. Communicate Proactively

Keep us informed about your progress.

If you have questions, ideas, technical problems, or concerns about a deadline, communicate early.

7. Finish Assignments Completely

A project may include the edit, captions, cover, post caption, final export, and scheduling.

Complete all assigned deliverables rather than leaving the final steps unfinished.

8. Respect Our Approval Process

You are encouraged to recommend changes and offer creative input.

Final decisions about content, messaging, branding, and publication remain with our team.



Compensation, Volume, and Turnaround

This is project-based work.

You will be paid for completed and approved videos, with rates confirmed before each assignment.

We anticipate approximately 30–50 short-form videos per month across our projects.

Your share of the workload will depend on quality, reliability, availability, and performance.



Additional expectations:

Project rates and deliverables are agreed upon before work begins.

Post captions and scheduling are included when specified in the per-video scope.

One round of revisions is included.

Corrections needed because the approved brief or template was not followed must be completed at no additional charge.

Batch deadlines will be agreed upon in advance.

Fast turnaround is appreciated, but accuracy and quality matter more than rushing.

Professional development opportunities: We are open to sponsoring approved training programs and courses for team members who demonstrate commitment and potential.



How to Apply

IMPORTANT: Use the subject line PURPLE VIDEO EDITOR.

Applications that don't follow the instructions may not be reviewed.

Please include the following:

1. Your Editing Portfolio

Send three short-form videos you've personally edited.

If available, include one long-form video.

For each example, briefly explain:

Which editing software you used.

What work you performed yourself.

Whether you used AI tools.

Approximately how long the edit took.



2. Proof of Social Media Results — Required

Provide at least one account you helped grow OR one successful post/video you created for a client.

Include:

The account or published content link.

Screenshots showing measurable results.

Your specific contribution.

A brief explanation of why the content performed well.

Applications without actual examples and performance screenshots will not be considered.



3. Creative Judgment: Show Us How You Think

Answer these three questions in your own words.



Question 1: The First Three Seconds

You're editing a video about an older mother with dementia who refuses to shower.

The video begins:

"Today, we're going to talk about showering and dementia."

Would you keep that opening or suggest something different?

Explain why and provide a stronger opening if you think one is needed.



Question 2: On-Screen Text

You're given this on-screen hook:

"Five things you should understand about why your mother who has dementia may suddenly start refusing to shower or bathe."

Would you use this as written?

If not, rewrite it and explain your reasoning.



Question 3: Speaking Up

You're editing a video, and you believe the instructions could lead to a less engaging result.

How would you approach that conversation with Elena?

We want to understand how you share ideas, handle creative differences, and communicate professionally.



4. Learning and Professional Development

Tell us:

Which editing programs you currently know.

Which AI tools you've used.

What editing or AI skill you would most like to learn.

Whether you've completed any editing or social media courses.

How you typically learn a new tool or technique.



5. Communication and Availability

Please provide:

Your normal working hours in Philippine time.

Whether you're comfortable with regular phone and video calls during Arizona business hours.

Your spoken and written English proficiency.

Your typical turnaround time.

The number of videos you can realistically edit each week.

Whether you're currently working with other clients.

Whether you have reliable internet and a backup connection.



6. Your Rates

Please provide your rates for:

Simple short-form editing.

Standard short-form editing.

Advanced short-form editing.

Long-form editing.



7. Professional Reference

If available, provide one client or employer reference who can speak to your editing quality, communication, and reliability.



Paid Editing Test and Hiring Process

Shortlisted applicants will receive the same raw footage, brand template, and editing brief.

You'll complete one 20–30 second paid editing test, with compensation agreed upon before starting.



We'll evaluate:

Creative judgment: Can you recognize a weak hook or suggest an improvement?

First three seconds: Is the opening attention-grabbing?

On-screen text: Is it clear, compelling, accurate, and well-positioned?

Editing quality: Are cuts, captions, B-roll, and audio polished?

Attention to detail: Did you follow the approved brand guidelines?

Initiative: Did you identify potential improvements without being prompted?

Communication: Can you explain your choices and discuss your ideas confidently?

Coachability: How well do you respond to feedback?

You'll also participate in a short video call to walk us through your editing choices and recommendations.

Test footage may not be published, reused, or shared.

Completing the paid test does not guarantee ongoing work.



Hiring Process:

Application review → Portfolio and performance verification → Creative interview → Paid editing test → Two-week trial → Ongoing collaboration



Who We're Hoping to Find



We're looking for someone who has already demonstrated that they can create effective social media content—but who is also excited to become even better.

Someone who notices when a hook is weak.

Someone who recognizes when on-screen text isn't working.

Someone who can confidently say, "I think there's a better way to do this," and explain why.

Someone who enjoys talking with the team, sharing ideas, receiving feedback, and learning new skills.

Someone who takes ownership of the work rather than waiting to be told every little thing.

We can invest in your technical development. What we're looking for from day one is creative judgment, proven initiative, excellent communication, and the willingness to grow.



If that sounds like you, we'd love to see your work.

title: Web Developer & AI Automation Engineer
description:
About The Ad Firm



Founded in 2009, The Ad Firm was born out of a mission to bring complete transparency, scientific performance, and high profitability to the digital marketing industry. Headquartered in Carlsbad, CA, we specialize in SEO, PPC, social media management, and custom web design for small and medium-sized businesses.

As we scale into 2026, we are expanding our tech stack. We need a dual-threat engineer who can reliably build and maintain client websites while simultaneously stepping up to help us pioneer and experiment with next-generation, autonomous AI agentic workflows.



Job Summary



We are seeking a versatile Web Developer & AI Automation Engineer to join our team. In this hybrid role, you will wear two hats. First, you will act as a core web developer, building high-performance, SEO-optimized websites, managing integrations, and maintaining clean codebase structures for our clients. Second, you will act as our junior AI specialist—helping us explore, build, and test Agentic AI Workflows that automate digital marketing pipelines (like automated content generation, ad auditing, and reporting loops).



This is the ultimate role for an established developer who wants to break heavily into AI and build hands-on experience with multi-agent systems, frameworks like LangGraph/CrewAI, and frontier LLMs under the guidance of our strategic roadmap.



About the Role



- Own the technical foundation of the websites we build

- Architect, develop, and optimize custom builds for SEO, performance, and scalability

- Work closely with SEO, Content, and Digital PR teams to ensure strong technical execution

- Build systems that are clean, scalable, and maintainable

- Focus on engineering quality over page builders or pre-built themes



Key Responsibilities



Web Development (Core Role)



- Architect and build fully custom WordPress websites (themes, plugins, ACF-driven structures)

- Engineer sites for speed, scalability, and strong Core Web Vitals performance

- Handle server environments, deployments, and infrastructure decisions

- Integrate APIs and third-party systems cleanly and reliably

- Own technical SEO implementation (crawlability, indexation, structured data)

- Manage DNS, CDN (Cloudflare), SMTP, and hosting configurations

- Work across Shopify and BigCommerce at the code level when needed

- Implement accurate tracking (GA4, GTM) without compromising data integrity

- Debug issues across the full stack (server, backend, frontend performance)



Agentic AI Workflows (Junior/Growth Role)



- Assist in constructing multi-step, dynamic agentic workflows utilizing the PTMRO framework (Planning, Tools, Memory, Reflection, Orchestration).

- Help connect AI agents to practical tools by writing scripts and utilizing web hooks to link LLMs with marketing APIs (Google Ads, Meta Graph API, analytics dashboards).

- Build and test simple evaluation loops, helping prompt engineering and agent behaviors self-correct or flag errors before output generation.

- Run experiments to optimize LLM token usage, latency, and agent reasoning structures for internal agency automation.



What We’re Looking For



Web Development Requirements (Mid-to-Senior)



- 5+ years of web development experience in agency or performance-driven environments

- Deep expertise in PHP (including WordPress core-level development)

- Strong JavaScript experience with modern frameworks and tooling

- Working knowledge of Python (automation, scraping, tooling)

- Proven experience building custom WordPress websites from scratch

- Strong understanding of technical SEO and its impact on architecture and performance

- Ability to diagnose and solve full-stack issues independently



AI & Automation Requirements (Junior / Entry-Level)



- Foundational AI Knowledge: A massive passion for AI agents and basic conceptual understanding of how LLMs process data, handle memory, and leverage external tools.

- Framework Exposure: Foundational exposure to or an eager willingness to learn agentic architectures like LangGraph, CrewAI, AutoGen, or Semantic Kernel (personal projects or bootcamps count!).

- Python Skills: Solid script-writing capabilities in Python to handle data manipulation and API calls.



What Sets You Apart



- You think in systems, not pages

- Experience working on large-scale or SEO-heavy websites

- Strong understanding of crawlability, indexation, and internal linking at scale

- Experience with schema and structured data implementation

- Exposure to programmatic SEO or dynamic page generation

- Experience handling real-world constraints (traffic spikes, broken deployments, legacy rebuilds)



Strong Advantages



- Experience with CI/CD pipelines and Git workflows

- Familiarity with Docker or modern dev environments

- Experience with log analysis and advanced debugging

- Security hardening and site recovery experience

- Experience with multi-site or multi-location SEO builds





What We Don’t Want



- Heavy reliance on page builders

- Plugin-first approaches to performance and SEO

- Developers who need constant direction or step-by-step instructions



Why Join Us?



- High ownership with real technical decision-making

- Clean builds with no unnecessary bloat

title: CEO for Small Business (Remote, US Business Hours)
description:
Finch Harbor is a managed services business. We hire Filipino professionals who work with our American small business clients. Finch Harbor employs you and pays you.



This role is with a window-cleaning company in Nashville, Tennessee, in business since 2013. The owner is our owner's sister. She has run it for 13 years, and she wants someone better than she is. We are looking for someone to revolutionize how it runs. This position takes ownership of the growth and management of the company.



What you'll do



Just like the owner does today, you'll start with the hands-on work:

• Run the company's reports by hand.

• Find missed punches on crew timesheets and get them corrected.

• Fill out employee write-ups.

• Call customers.



As you learn the business:

• Build a deep understanding of the company's market and every business process.

• Bring analytical management to the company: measure what is working and what is not, and act on it.



Over time:

• Take over the growth and management of the company.

• Ensure the business is on track to improve performance and resume meeting its growth goals.

• Lead the company's people.



How the role works



You will assist with and oversee all administrative and management functions for the company's Filipino office staff. You will direct the line managers on improvements, discipline and incentives, based on data, and rely on their expertise for supervision on the ground. The field managers who run the crews are experts in safety and skilled work. You will enforce company policy while building a collaborative relationship with them.



This is not a temporary job. The first months are detailed, hands-on work, and it grows into running the company. The business has been stable for 13 years and is the leading window-cleaning company in its region. The company has hired strong former leaders before, and they have typically grown it by 20% a year or more. Our vision is a $15 million company. If you make a big dent toward that vision, there are significant opportunities for growth, and your income grows with it.



Requirements



We only review applications that meet every requirement.

• You have run a company or a whole department, in the Philippines or abroad, and overseen around 50 people. You have at least 5 years as a people leader.

• C2-level English, spoken and written. The interviews are conducted entirely in English.

• Full-time during US business hours, Central Time. That is overnight in the Philippines, so confirm you can sustain a night schedule.

• Your own laptop, stable internet and a quiet place to work.

• A background check before any offer. We verify your employment and education, including the positions you held and your dates in each role.



Preferred

• An MBA.

• A college degree.



What we offer

• A salary of $2,000 a month, for 40 to 50 hours a week.

• After each quarter in which you grow the company at an annual rate of at least 20%, the owner pays you a fixed incentive, discussed at interview.



Start date



We'd like you to start within two weeks. If you need to give notice to your current employer, we'll work around it.



To apply



Apply through OnlineJobs.ph. In your application, tell us about a business or department you turned from declining to growing, with the numbers.

title: International Logistics Manager
description:
Now Hiring: International Logistics Manager



TETON is a fast-growing Outdoor Brand based in Salt Lake City, Utah. We are passionate about our goal - providing one billion and one outdoor experiences. How do we accomplish this? We make cool outdoor gear like sleeping bags, camp pads, backpacks, cots, and tents. Why? Because we think being outdoors and enjoying nature gives a little extra happiness in one's life.



Location: Remote – Philippines (Online Specialist)

Employment: Full-Time, 40 hours per week

Schedule: Flexible, with required overlap across U.S. and international time zones

Reports to: Director of Operations



Position Overview

Teton is seeking an experienced, proactive International Logistics Manager to oversee international freight operations, lead our logistics team, and identify opportunities to reduce costs and improve efficiency.

This position manages shipments from our international factories to Teton's U.S. and Canadian warehouses, third-party logistics (3PL) facilities, and retail and wholesale clients receiving products directly from our factories.

We're looking for an independent problem-solver who takes ownership, negotiates effectively, builds strong relationships, and continuously looks for better ways to operate.



Key Responsibilities

International Freight & Direct Import Management

• Oversee international shipments from factory readiness through final delivery and receipt.

• Coordinate with factories, freight forwarders, ocean carriers, drayage providers, warehouses, and 3PL partners.

• Manage client Direct Import shipments, including bookings, routing, documentation, and client-specific requirements.

• Proactively resolve shipment delays, booking issues, equipment shortages, and other transportation challenges.

• Optimize container utilization, shipment consolidation, routing, and delivery schedules.

• Coordinate with outsourced customs clearance partners and ensure accurate, timely shipping documentation.

• Oversee cargo protection standards, transportation-related damage investigations, freight claims, and receiving discrepancies.

• Develop contingency plans to minimize shipping disruptions and maintain reliable delivery performance.

Freight Cost Optimization & Strategic Development

• Research, compare, and negotiate competitive freight rates and transportation agreements.

• Identify opportunities for direct drayage contracts, alternative shipping routes, and other cost-saving arrangements.

• Audit freight invoices, challenge unnecessary charges, and pursue appropriate credits or refunds.

• Monitor freight costs, budgets, and carrier performance, providing analysis and recommendations to leadership.

• Research and evaluate new 3PL partners and opportunities to expand or optimize Teton's fulfillment network.

• Develop cost-benefit analyses and recommendations for logistics improvements and strategic initiatives.

Logistics Systems & Process Improvement

• Maintain accurate shipment tracking, milestone visibility, and logistics reporting using systems such as Airtable and Fishbowl.

• Establish and improve procedures, documentation standards, and performance metrics.

• Identify opportunities to improve efficiency through technology, AI, and automation.

• Monitor logistics KPIs, including freight costs, transit times, on-time delivery, and provider performance.

Team Leadership & Collaboration

• Directly manage and develop the Inbound Logistics Coordinator and other logistics support personnel.

• Establish clear priorities, accountability, and effective coverage across international time zones.

• Collaborate closely with the Supply Chain Manager to coordinate shipping schedules with production and replenishment needs.

• Ensure continued support for factory purchase order submissions under the Supply Chain Manager's direction.

• Serve as the primary contact for logistics issues, communicating proactively with internal teams and external partners.



Required Qualifications

• 5+ years of experience in international logistics, ocean freight, freight forwarding, or transportation management.

• Strong knowledge of container shipping and international freight operations, particularly from Asia to North America.

• Proven experience negotiating freight rates, evaluating transportation options, and identifying cost savings.

• Excellent analytical skills, including Excel proficiency and transportation cost analysis.

• Strong problem-solving skills with the ability to independently manage complex logistics challenges.

• Experience leading or supervising logistics personnel.

• Excellent English communication, organization, and relationship-management skills.

• Working knowledge of Incoterms, shipping documentation, and international trade processes.

• Ability to manage a flexible schedule and collaborate effectively across time zones.

Preferred Qualifications

• Experience with direct drayage arrangements, 3PL evaluation, or logistics network optimization.

• Experience managing Direct Import shipments for major retailers, including Amazon.

• Familiarity with Amazon Global, Vendor Central, Century VMS, or similar booking platforms.

• Experience with Airtable, Fishbowl, or transportation management systems.

• Experience with freight claims, cargo damage investigations, and freight cost auditing.

• Experience using AI, automation, or technology to improve logistics operations.



Work Schedule

This is a full-time, 40-hour-per-week position with a flexible schedule designed to support collaboration across U.S. and international time zones.

The selected candidate must be available for Teton's weekly Tuesday leadership meeting from 9:00–10:30 AM Mountain Time and maintain sufficient overlap with U.S.-based teams, freight providers, international partners, and direct reports.

The specific schedule will be established collaboratively to ensure effective communication and operational coverage.



What Success Looks Like

• International shipments run smoothly, with issues anticipated and resolved proactively.

• Freight costs are actively managed, with measurable savings and improved provider performance.

• Shipment tracking and communication are accurate, timely, and reliable.

• Logistics personnel are well-managed, accountable, and effective.

• Teton's logistics network becomes more efficient, cost-effective, and scalable.



How to Apply



• Use 8 or MORE Apply Points

• Attach your updated résumé

• Send a brief introduction explaining why you would be a good fit for this role.

• Include a current internet-speed test.

• Share the best times to contact you for an interview. (We are MDT, Mountain Daylight Time)

• Before applying, please visit 
 to learn more about our products and company.
